name: Personalized Crystal Heart With LED Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from premium crystal and a durable LED base, offering an elegant, modern, and eye-catching display finish.
    - Features a heart-shaped crystal design that creates a meaningful and sophisticated keepsake.
    - Crystal thickness: 1.5 cm ~ 0.59 in, providing a solid and premium feel with beautiful light reflection.
    - The LED base enhances the crystal artwork with a glowing display effect, making the design more vivid and attractive.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Crystal size: 4 x 3.6 in ~ 10.16 x 9.14 cm
    - LED base size: 8 x 2.7 cm~ 3.15 x 1.1 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports single-sided printing or double-sided printing based on customer preference.

 

  • Lighting & Power Options:
    - Equipped with a touch-switch LED base that supports multiple lighting modes.
    - Touch modes include:
                     +) 1st touch: slowly changing colors
                     +) 2nd touch: quickly changing colors
                     +) 3rd touch: constant white light
                     +) 4th touch: constant red light
                     +) 5th touch: constant blue light
                     +) 6th touch: constant green light
    - Powered by USB cable (included) or 3 AAA batteries (not included).

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized crystal keepsake and an LED decorative light.
    - Designed to brighten up bedrooms, desks, shelves, nightstands, or memory corners.
    - Creates a soft, glowing effect that enhances custom photos and meaningful artwork.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, graduation gifts, romantic keepsakes, and celebration displays.
    - Perfect for combining sentimental value with elegant decorative lighting.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, classmates, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for graduations, birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for romantic gifts, memorial keepsakes, and family memory displays.
    - A thoughtful gift for students, graduates, couples, and anyone who loves personalized décor.
    - Great for bedroom décor, desk display, and memorable milestone gifts.
    - Adds a warm, elegant, and heartfelt touch to any personal space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Personalized Crystal Heart With LED Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
